title: Duplicate refunds issued on retry (ORD-1042, ORD-1043)
body:
Customers on ORD-1042 and ORD-1043 were refunded two or three times for one request (same idempotency key; see payments.refunds). Finance reconciliation for INC-4471 flags them. CI job `test-refunds` fails on main.
